== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Away Put Your Weapon (V) (Virtual Block 2) (Card list text)|Away Put Your Weapon (V) (Errata 3)]] (<code>1220_139</code>, Virtual Block 2 slip 139E), showing the '''PC-E3''' game text. No published image shows this text: the Virtual Block 2 release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB2-139E-Away_Put_Your_Weapon.png]]) shows the PC-E2 text of [[Away Put Your Weapon (V) (Virtual Block 2) (Release sheet)|Away Put Your Weapon (V) (Errata 2)]], and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB2-L-awayputyourweapon-pre.gif]], numbered 140E) prints the PC-E1 wording ([[Away Put Your Weapon (V) (Errata)]]) (“up to 5 weapons … one retrieved card”) without the card list's “retireved” typo.

* '''Text source:''' Players Committee website card list (VBlock2Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064711/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock2Type.html 2012-07-21] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111142857/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock2Type.html 2013-01-11] (Internet Archive). The card list drops icons; the icons are those of the printed slip, drawn as icons. Published typos are kept as printed. The card-list entry is marked “Errata Text - September 9th, 2009”.
* '''PC-E3 text:''' “USED: An opponent's just drawn [Permanent Weapon] weapon destiny is -3. (Immune to Sense.) LOST: Once per game, retrieve up to 5 weapons (may take one retireved card into hand).”
* '''Made:''' 8 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 71) from the card's own Virtual Legacy card (<code>1220_139</code>: Decipher art, frame, title, lore, icons, Virtual Block 2 set mark, slip number 140E as on the Players Committee card image, copyright line) with the PC-E3 game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039. Rebuild spec: <code>VB2-139E-Away_Put_Your_Weapon-PC-E3-cardmaker.png.spec.json</code> in the batch B05 run folder.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
* '''Renamed:''' 11 November 2026 from <code>VB2-139E-Away_Put_Your_Weapon-PC-E1-cardmaker.png</code>: the versions were put in date order (Batch S1, versions ruling of 11 November 2026). The image itself is unchanged.
